description: This source file defines a custom React hook 'useTestMCPConnection' that manages the state and logic for testing connections to an MCP server within a web application's UI. It handles fetching tools list from the server based on form inputs, manages loading/error states, and exposes functions to trigger or reset the fetch operation.

methods.name: useTestMCPConnection
methods.description: A React hook that manages the process of testing an MCP server connection, including fetching available tools and handling related state.
